node.title: Repeat question
node.author: hchana
node.doctext:
Hi, How do I adjust the code below so it re-iterates a question that was answered incorrectly.? Presently, if you get a question wrong, a new question is generated. Help

#!/usr/bin/perl use strict; use warnings; use diagnostics; use feature 'say'; use feature "switch"; my $input = 0; my $play_again = 0; srand; while () { my $random_integer1=int(rand(100)); #generate a random integer from 0 to 99 my $random_integer2=int(rand(100)); #generate a random integer from 0 to 99 if ($random_integer1 > $random_integer2){ print "What is $random_integer1 - $random_integer2 = "; $input = ; if ($input == $random_integer1 - $random_integer2){ print "Well done.! you are corect.\n\n"; }else{ print "Sorry you're wrong, have another go.\n\n"; } }else{ print "What is $random_integer1 + $random_integer2 = "; $input = ; if ($input == $random_integer1 + $random_integer2){ print "Well done.! you are corect.\n\n"; }else{ print "Sorry you're wrong, have another go.\n\n"; } } }
